name: Noxious Ghoul

abilities.text: Whenever ~ or another Zombie enters, all non-Zombie creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn.

notes: 'Another Zombie' is any player's Zombie, so the second half of the or event carries no controller; pump takes no filter, so 'all non-Zombie creatures' is a for-each over every creature that is not a Zombie (the set defaults to every player's battlefield).

issues: Whenever this creature or another Zombie enters — expected Fires on Noxious Ghoul entering and on ANY player's other Zombie entering. — scripted event 'or' of {etb self:true} and {etb self:false, filter:{subtypes:['Zombie'], other:true}} with no controller key. game.ts:2168 leaves an etb with no `controller` unrestricted, so any player's Zombie fires it; `other:true` is redundant because self:false already requires ctx.obj !== perm. Correct.

all non-Zombie creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn — expected Every creature on the battlefield that is not a Zombie, any controller, -1/-1 until end of turn (a one-shot, so creatures entering later are unaffected). — scripted for-each over {types:['Creature'], notSubtypes:['Zombie']} with pump target 'that', -1/-1, duration 'eot'. The set has no `who`, and framelessSet (characteristics.ts:196) defaults an absent `who` to every player, so opponents' creatures are included; notSubtypes is honoured at characteristics.ts:225. The render 'for each creature' drops notSubtypes — that is a render.ts gap and the sole cause of the 0.65 round-trip, not an engine one.

Whenever this creature or another Zombie enters, all non-Zombie creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn. — expected triggers on itself entering OR any other Zombie (any controller) entering, once per event; -1/-1 until EOT to every non-Zombie creature on any battlefield — scripted event 'or' of [etb self:true, etb self:false filter{subtypes:['Zombie'], other:true}] — the two branches are mutually exclusive at game.ts:2168 (self branch needs ctx.obj===perm, other branch needs ctx.obj!==perm), so it fires exactly once; no controller restriction, matching 'another Zombie' regardless of controller. Effect is for-each over {types:['Creature'], notSubtypes:['Zombie']} with pump -1/-1 duration eot; objectsIn defaults to all players (refs.ts:143) and matchesFilter honors notSubtypes (characteristics.ts:225). Blind scenario 2 confirms Walking Corpse and Noxious Ghoul stay 2/2 and 3/3. — CR 603.2; 613.4c; 704.5f

all non-Zombie creatures get -1/-1 until end of turn — expected one continuous effect over the set locked in at resolution — scripted expressed as a for-each snapshot loop rather than a single set-wide pump. Result is identical (set determined at resolution, later entrants unaffected, a creature that later becomes a Zombie keeps the -1/-1). roundTrip 0.65 reflects the renderer flattening 'for each creature, that permanent gets -1/-1' and dropping 'non-Zombie', not an engine divergence. — CR 611.2c
